extracted.name: Cheddar-Beer Fondue
extracted.description: Cheddar and beer fondue is easy to prepare and is perfect for dipping bread, vegetables, or apples at your next dinner party or special occasion.
instruction_lines: Mix Cheddar cheese and flour together in a bowl.

Bring beer to a light boil in a fondue pot; add garlic, Worcestershire sauce, and mustard powder and stir. Gradually stir cheese mixture into beer mixture. Reduce heat to low; cook and stir mixture until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.
